items.question: During the Cosflourish Lake's approach to the South Texas Gateway Terminal in Ingleside, which tugboat was made fast at the very back of the tanker, and which one was held in reserve?
items.expected_answer: The no. 4 tug, Mercury, was at the stern, and the no. 5 tug, Zeus, was the standby tug.

evidence.quote: The pilots assigned numbers to the tugs from bow to stern, with the no. 1 tug (Ted C Litton) being the first tug at the bow, the no. 2 tug (Connolly M) on the port shoulder, the no. 3 tug (Cooper K) on the port quarter, the no. 4 tug (Mercury) at the stern, and the no. 5 tug (Zeus) as the standby tug.

items.notes: Cross-chunk factual: the tug assignment passage spans the chunk boundary after 'from bow'.

items.question: According to the casualty summary, how many persons were on board the Cosflourish Lake during the docking at the South Texas Gateway Terminal, and how many of them were pilots?
items.expected_answer: There were 34 persons on board: 31 crew and 3 pilots.

evidence.quote: Persons on board 34 (31 crew and 3 pilots)
